falsifiable_hypothesis: The raw response-free cross-patient bandwidth estimator has the lowest mean development error but misses one outer-fold gate by a tiny margin, while standard jackknife bias correction restores five-fold stability at a very small mean-error cost. A fixed 50/50 output hedge can cancel estimator-specific perturbations without any per-fold or per-target routing.
blend_rule: For every held sample, target and orientation, predict q=0.5*q_jackknife_bias_corrected+0.5*q_raw_cross_patient. The weight is a fixed symmetry hedge, not selected by a grid. Both components use the same authenticated 64-well task and whole-patient outer splits. No new fitting, no per-fold/target weights, no protected data.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average A/B predictions
